page.overview:
Who is Moulon?

Don Moulon was the boss of the Moulon Family.

Although not personally seen, Moulon can be described as an obsessive individual. According to Reuven and Moulon's own subordinates, he has tried numerous times to kidnap Candelle, the queen of Esperia. He eventually became fed up with his failures, to the point he considered it fine to kill her should she refuse again.

As the boss of the Moulon Family, Moulon has at least 17 well-armed subordinates willing to do his bidding.

Since at least 70 years ago, Moulon made many attempts to kidnap Candelle in order to force her to be his lover. However, his family suffered failure after failure in that regard, causing him great frustration. 70 years ago, Moulon had his subordinates attack the Opera House on Esperia for one final showdown, allowing them to even kill her should she refuse again. However, his lackeys happened to run into Brook earlier that day, leading to their swift defeat as his attack finally struck them.
